dispatch_scope: Narrow bootstrap adapter only: derives actual CPU job directory, reads root-finalized config SHA after held submission, verifies immutable config and accepted CPU/R5 manifest pins, then execs unchanged accepted launch.sh. Does not edit source, authorize model stages, wait for mutable configuration or contact scheduler.

placement_observation.source: Actual sinfo/squeue/sshare read-only commands in this worker turn
placement_observation.reason: Highest currently reported user fairshare among returned CPU accounts; no start-time guarantee. Root should compare actual test-only forecasts with beto and bjhz immediately before submission.75min requires normal cpu only; never widen this job to cpu-interactive.

root_sequence.action: Verify live usage/session and read current primary RESUME; keep all GPU/model admission gates. Create the dedicated root bootstrap log directory; all future per-job directories are new, no historical output reuse.
Root test-only placement forecast may use identical resource arguments below with --test-only instead of --hold/--parsable. This worker has not run a test-only submission.
Root held-submit exact normal-CPU request using held_submit_argv. Record actual job through RS immediately. The fixed dispatch path exists before submission and needs no future GPU identity.

Read actual held job identity/account/partition/time/CPUs/memory/noGPU/no-requeue. Create rootbase/job-CPUJOB only after actual ID is known. Copy config.seed.json to that new directory with exclusive creation, replacing ONLY the fields listed below.

Compute canonical config.json SHA; write config.sha256 as one lowercase64hex line using exclusive creation. Root independently reviews complete config/base parameters/all source and G3/ref pins; publish an immutable publication.json binding actual CPUjob, config SHA, dispatch SHA, accepted CPU manifest, R5 manifest and placement. Make finalized config/digest/publication read-only. Never modify after release.

Root releases that held CPU job only after publication checks; accepted supervisor validates actual allocation and emits evidence/READY.json. Root arms/re-arms its actual job waiter and records RS state. READY grants no model or GPU authority.

Only after actual CPU READY, root may perform separately approved GPU held-submit/reservation/completed successor mapping/final R5 binding. First fresh actual bank WAITING request binds actual GPUjob and final GPU-config SHA; preserve those sticky identities through prefix. Root request must arrive within15s and guard must finish before WAITING+270s. No request retry/retarget.

Root uses only timely phase COMPLETE plus separately fresh actual ledger/mapping/exact+rounded caps to create a new composite model-phase preflight attestation. CPU COMPLETE stays immutable. Repeat actual Delta owning calls for prefix; Bridge byte-equivalence is not a model-phase substitute.

root_fields_to_finalize.standing_CPU_job_id: actual held-submitted numeric CPU job ID, as a string

future_GPU_bindings: Do not add future final_GPU_bound_config_sha256 to startup config. It is learned once from root bank request and checked against the actual WAITING marker; same value required for prefix.
